headlines.description: — Sam Reinhart scored two goals, helping the Florida Panthers beat the Washington Capitals 5-3 on Monday night and giving the back-to-back Stanley Cup champions nine wins in their past 12 games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Reinhart scores twice as Panthers beat Capitals 5-3, giving Florida 9th win in 12 games

events.name: New York Rangers at Carolina Hurricanes

headlines.description: — Jackson Blake’s power-play goal on a deflection 4:47 into overtime lifted the Carolina Hurricanes to a 3-2 win over the New York Rangers on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jackson Blake’s overtime goal lifts Hurricanes past Rangers 3-2

events.name: Columbus Blue Jackets at Ottawa Senators

headlines.description: — Calvin Pickard made 41 saves to help the Edmonton Oilers beat the Winnipeg Jets 3-1 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Calvin Pickard makes 41 saves in the Oilers' 3-1 win over the Jets

events.name: Buffalo Sabres at St. Louis Blues

headlines.description: — Zach Benson and Alex Tuch scored and the Buffalo Sabres beat the St. Louis Blues 4-2 on Monday night for their ninth straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tuch scores in 3rd period, Sabres beat Blues 4-2 for 9th straight victory

events.name: Los Angeles Kings at Colorado Avalanche

headlines.description: — Nathan MacKinnon scored the 399th goal of his career, Brock Nelson had a goal and an assist, and the surging Colorado Avalanche won their eighth in a row, 5-2 over the Los Angeles Kings on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: MacKinnon scores 399th career goal as surging Avalanche beat Kings 5-2

headlines.description: — Steve Stamkos scored two goals less than two minutes apart in the third period to rally the Nashville Predators to a 4-3 victory over the Utah Mammoth on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steve Stamkos scores twice in third period to rally Nashville past Utah, 4-3

headlines.description: — Connor Zary scored off a scramble in front of the goal on a power play at 1:53 of overtime to give the Calgary Flames a 2-1 victory over Boston on...
headlines.shortLinkText: Connor Zary scores on OT power play to lift the Flames past the Bruins, 2-1

events.name: Minnesota Wild at Vegas Golden Knights

headlines.description: — Marcus Johansson had a goal and three assists and the surging Minnesota Wild beat the Vegas Golden Knights 5-2 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wild beat Golden Knights 5-2 to improve to 9-1-1 since Dec. 8

events.name: San Jose Sharks at Anaheim Ducks

headlines.description: — Macklin Celebrini became the third player with 60 points this season with a goal and two assists in the San Jose Sharks' 5-4 victory over the Anaheim Ducks on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Macklin Celebrini hits 60 points with goal, 2 assists in Sharks' 5-4 victory over Ducks

headlines.description: — Kevin Lankinen made 37 saves and Liam Ohgren had the lone shootout goal in the Vancouver Canucks' 3-2 victory over the Seattle Kraken on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Liam Ohgren scores lone shootout goal to lift Canucks past Kraken, 3-2
